SpareBank 1 Utvikling is the SpareBank 1 banks' joint company for development, operations, procurement and branding, and has one of Norway's largest in-house development environments. In summer 2026 I worked eight weeks as a developer in Oslo, in a cross-functional team of two designers and four developers building a new housing savings product for young adults aged 18 to 28. My main contribution was a rule-based recommendation system that analyzes transaction data and compares actual spending with SIFO's reference budget to give personal savings advice. The work gave me practical insight into what financial data looks like in production — noisy, unevenly categorized and full of edge cases — and into the need for explainability when advice concerns someone's personal finances. I also developed new features in an existing codebase, wrote technical documentation and unit and integration tests, fixed and debugged bugs, and took part in daily stand-ups and other Scrum ceremonies.

experiences.position: Student Assistant for Programming, Numerics and Security
experiences.description: The course provides an interdisciplinary introduction to programming, numerical mathematics and ICT security, and is common to all engineering students. Students learn to use Python to solve technical problems, analyze numerical calculations and visualize data, while gaining basic insight into digital threats and risk assessment. Teaching emphasizes practical application through weekly exercises and final assessment in both programming and ICT security. I completed this student assistant role in December 2025.

Engage Resource Hub is part of the Engage Center for Entrepreneurship at NTNU, established under the Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management. It collaborates with various study programs to offer educators resources that can be used in their own teaching. My role involves administering and publishing learning content on the platform, supporting the development of new features, and contributing to technical and design improvements. I completed this student assistant role in December 2025.
